issues.evidence: The subtitle '讨论是否继续周五延时开放。' (resolved from text-0) appears on the cover with significantly smaller size (20px) and lighter gray color than the title, and while this is appropriate for a subtitle, the cover otherwise presents no supporting data preview, making the single-line subtitle visually underweighted relative to the large empty middle region.
issues.suggestedChange: This is a deliberate cover hierarchy, not a defect; no change needed.

issues.evidence: The text frame 'text-2' (x648, y331, w233, h147) is rendered with a single line near the top and large unused space; no glyphs cross the boundary, so this is unused space rather than clipping.
